blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol – The League of Municipalities of the Philippines (LMP)-Bohol Chapter has asked the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) to remove a requirement for local government units (LGUs) to have obligated at least 75 percent of their annual development fund as of September 30 to qualify for the 2026 Collective Negotiation Agreement (CNA) incentive. In Resolution No. 020, Series of 2026, adopted on Monday, Nov. 9, the LMP-Bohol Chapter said the requirement under DBM Budget Circular No. 2026-1, issued on Nov. 4, was impractical and difficult for many municipalities to meet.
